name: Jorah errands
description: Exact one-shot reminder jobs in Adam's time zone (reminder_job), price maths for any shopping comparison (price_compare), and a private record of things Adam buys again with run-out and reorder dates worked out in code (supply_list, supply_plan, supply_save, supply_forget). It sends nothing, schedules nothing itself and uses no network; its state stays on the PC, mode 700.

stateDir.description: The supplies record (private: it may hold a prescription); mode 700, files 600

timeZone.description: Adam's time zone, for every date and reminder time

remindTime.description: Default time of day for date reminders, HH:MM (09:00)
